package moba

import (
	"cmp"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/lockstep"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/nettransport"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
)

var ErrBusy = errors.New("moba: room queue full or draining")

type PersistRound func(context.Context, Change) (Round, error)
type stagedPacket struct {
	session nettransport.SessionID
	raw     []byte
}

// Room 由 Actor 的唯一 goroutine 驱动。Match 先切帧到有界暂存区，权威 Sender 确认持久化后才广播。
// 这里只实现样例宿主；固定权威 Round Entity 是唯一持久事实，不在每个宿主复制另一套存储。
type Room struct {
	match   *lockstep.Match
	record  Round // 只在权威提交成功后替换：len(record.Frames) 就是已提交帧数
	persist PersistRound
	wire    nettransport.DatagramSender
	staged  []stagedPacket
	stopped bool
	// checkpoints 非 nil 表示开了快照恢复（RecoverRoomWithSnapshots）：每 every 帧在提交成功后发布一份已提交检查点。
	checkpoints *ArenaCheckpoints
	every       lockstep.FrameID
}

// RoomSnapshots 打开 Room 的框架恢复（追帧页 + 快照，Recovery 零值即 auto）。
// 追帧页与快照分块由 Match 的后台 goroutine 经 Reliable 发出、不经暂存区，所以 Match 配已提交门
// （MatchConfig.CommittedFrame = 已提交帧数）：可靠通道上只发已提交的帧；检查点只取权威提交返回的参考状态。
// 窗口（64 帧）内的缺口走追帧页，越过窗口走快照；持久日志分页（replay）留给没有快照能力的客户端与观战 / 回放。
type RoomSnapshots struct {
	Reliable    nettransport.ReliableSender
	Checkpoints *ArenaCheckpoints
	// CheckpointEvery 是发布检查点的帧间隔；0 取 16。必须小于 64 帧窗口，否则最新检查点可能早于快照请求的下界。
	CheckpointEvery int
}

// RecoverRoom 按已提交记录重建房间；没有可靠通道，窗口外的帧由 replay 从持久日志分页补。
func RecoverRoom(record Round, persist PersistRound, wire nettransport.DatagramSender) (*Room, error) {
	return recoverRoom(record, persist, wire, RoomSnapshots{})
}

// RecoverRoomWithSnapshots 是开了快照恢复的 RecoverRoom：重建完 Match 后先发布已提交头部的检查点，
// 交接 / 重启后的新宿主立刻能服务快照。
func RecoverRoomWithSnapshots(record Round, persist PersistRound, wire nettransport.DatagramSender, snapshots RoomSnapshots) (*Room, error) {
	if snapshots.Reliable == nil || snapshots.Checkpoints == nil || snapshots.CheckpointEvery < 0 || snapshots.CheckpointEvery >= lockstep.MinHistoryRetainFrames {
		return nil, ErrRule
	}
	return recoverRoom(record, persist, wire, snapshots)
}

func recoverRoom(record Round, persist PersistRound, wire nettransport.DatagramSender, snapshots RoomSnapshots) (*Room, error) {
	checked, err := DecodeRound(record.Encode())
	if err != nil || checked.Phase != "playing" && checked.Phase != "ended" || persist == nil || wire == nil {
		return nil, ErrRule
	}
	r := &Room{record: checked, persist: persist, wire: wire, checkpoints: snapshots.Checkpoints, every: lockstep.FrameID(cmp.Or(snapshots.CheckpointEvery, 16))}
	sink := nettransport.TransportFunc{Datagram: func(_ context.Context, s nettransport.SessionID, raw []byte) error {
		if len(r.staged) >= ArenaSeats {
			return ErrBusy
		}
		r.staged = append(r.staged, stagedPacket{s, append([]byte(nil), raw...)})
		return nil
	}}
	seats := make([]lockstep.PlayerID, ArenaSeats)
	for i := range seats {
		seats[i] = lockstep.PlayerID(i + 1)
	}
	config := lockstep.MatchConfig{Sequencer: lockstep.SequencerConfig{Players: seats, MaxInputBytes: 4}, RedundancyDepth: 3, HistoryRetainFrames: lockstep.MinHistoryRetainFrames, Datagrams: sink}
	if r.checkpoints != nil {
		// 已提交门：CommittedFrame 在 Tick 的协程（Actor）上调用，读 owner 自己的 record，不用锁。
		config.Reliable = snapshots.Reliable
		config.Snapshots = lockstep.SnapshotConfig{Provider: r.checkpoints}
		config.CommittedFrame = func() lockstep.FrameID { return lockstep.FrameID(len(r.record.Frames)) }
	}
	r.match, err = lockstep.NewMatch(config)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// 公开 API 重新喂入已提交帧，重建 Sequencer / History / 冗余编码器；未 Attach，恢复过程不对外广播。
	for _, saved := range checked.Frames {
		for _, in := range saved.Inputs {
			if _, err := r.match.SubmitInput(in.Player, saved.ID, in.Payload); err != nil {
				r.Close()
				return nil, err
			}
		}
		if _, err := r.match.Tick(context.Background()); err != nil {
			r.Close()
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if r.checkpoints != nil {
		r.checkpoints.Publish(checked.Reference) // DecodeRound 已核对它等于已提交日志的重算结果
	}
	return r, nil
}
func (r *Room) Close() {
	if r.stopped {
		return
	}
	r.stopped = true
	r.staged = nil
	r.match.Close()
}
func (r *Room) bind(playerID int64, sid int32, epoch uint64, session nettransport.SessionID) error {
	if r.stopped || epoch != r.record.Epoch || session == 0 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	for i, m := range r.record.Members {
		if m.PlayerID == playerID && m.SID == sid {
			return r.match.Attach(lockstep.PlayerID(i+1), session)
		}
	}
	return ErrRule
}
func (r *Room) input(epoch uint64, session nettransport.SessionID, frame lockstep.FrameID, raw []byte) error {
	// 本宿主只收当前未切帧：回复仅表示暂存，切帧提交才确认执行。崩溃后未提交输入由客户端重新提交。
	// 不折叠已提交帧、不持有未来帧，恢复时无需猜测旧输入的迟到折叠身份。
	if r.stopped || epoch != r.record.Epoch || frame != r.match.NextFrame() || r.record.Phase != "playing" {
		return ErrRule
	}
	if _, err := DecodeArena(raw); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return r.match.HandleCommand(session, lockstep.Command{Operation: lockstep.OpInput, Frame: frame, Payload: raw})
}

// catchup 是客户端的 OpCatchup(from)：走追帧页还是快照由 Match 判定。没开快照恢复的房间没有可靠通道，返回
// lockstep.ErrCatchupUnavailable，客户端改用 replay。
func (r *Room) catchup(epoch uint64, session nettransport.SessionID, from lockstep.FrameID) error {
	if r.stopped || epoch != r.record.Epoch {
		return ErrRule
	}
	return r.match.HandleCommand(session, lockstep.Command{Operation: lockstep.OpCatchup, Frame: from})
}
func (r *Room) tick(ctx context.Context) (lockstep.Frame, error) {
	if r.stopped || r.record.Phase != "playing" {
		return lockstep.Frame{}, ErrRule
	}
	r.staged = nil
	f, sendErr := r.match.Tick(ctx)
	if f.ID == 0 {
		r.Close()
		return f, cmp.Or(sendErr, ErrRule)
	}
	// 帧已切出时 Tick 的错误只说明部分发送失败（暂存区满、某个会话的追帧页 / 快照分块没发出）：
	// 只影响对应会话的恢复，照常提交，不停房间。
	saved, err := r.persist(ctx, Change{Op: "frame", HostSID: r.record.HostSID, Epoch: r.record.Epoch, Frame: f})
	if err != nil {
		r.Close()
		return f, err
	} // 包括结果未知：不发送、不再推进；重启查询原局。
	if saved.HostSID != r.record.HostSID || saved.Epoch != r.record.Epoch || len(saved.Frames) != int(f.ID) {
		r.Close()
		return f, ErrRule
	}
	r.record = saved
	if r.checkpoints != nil && f.ID%r.every == 0 {
		// 检查点只取已提交状态：saved.Reference 是权威实体按已提交日志重算的参考模拟，帧号 = len(saved.Frames)。
		r.checkpoints.Publish(saved.Reference)
	}
	packets := r.staged
	r.staged = nil
	errs := []error{sendErr}
	for _, p := range packets {
		if err := r.wire.SendDatagram(ctx, p.session, p.raw); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, err)
		}
	}
	// 发送失败不回滚已经持久的帧；客户端按同一局 / epoch 查询已提交历史补齐。
	return f, errors.Join(errs...)
}

type RoomRequest struct {
	Op        string
	Epoch     uint64
	PlayerID  int64
	PlayerSID int32
	Session   nettransport.SessionID
	Frame     lockstep.FrameID
	Payload   []byte
}
type RoomReply struct {
	Frame  lockstep.Frame
	Next   lockstep.FrameID
	Digest string
	Frames []lockstep.Frame
}
type roomCall struct {
	ctx     context.Context
	request RoomRequest
	done    chan roomAnswer
}
type roomAnswer struct {
	reply RoomReply
	err   error
}

// Actor 使用固定容量邮箱；排空关闭准入，等待真正结束才释放 Room。排队 / 在途超时都不能解释成未执行。
type Actor struct {
	room       *Room
	queue      chan roomCall
	stop, done chan struct{}
	once       sync.Once
	accepting  atomic.Bool
}

func NewActor(r *Room) *Actor {
	a := &Actor{room: r, queue: make(chan roomCall, 32), stop: make(chan struct{}), done: make(chan struct{})}
	a.accepting.Store(true)
	go a.run()
	return a
}
func (a *Actor) Call(ctx context.Context, req RoomRequest) (RoomReply, error) {
	if !a.accepting.Load() {
		return RoomReply{}, ErrBusy
	}
	req.Payload = append([]byte(nil), req.Payload...)
	c := roomCall{ctx: ctx, request: req, done: make(chan roomAnswer, 1)}
	select {
	case <-a.stop:
		return RoomReply{}, ErrBusy
	case a.queue <- c:
	default:
		return RoomReply{}, ErrBusy
	}
	select {
	case out := <-c.done:
		return out.reply, out.err
	case <-a.done:
		// 准入前观察与 Stop 之间可能交错，已结束 owner 不会再消费晚入队请求。
		// 已执行请求优先取其结果；其余明确拒绝，不让 Background 调用永久等候。
		select {
		case out := <-c.done:
			return out.reply, out.err
		default:
			return RoomReply{}, ErrBusy
		}
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return RoomReply{}, ctx.Err()
	}
}
func (a *Actor) run() {
	defer close(a.done)
	defer a.room.Close()
	for {
		select {
		case <-a.stop:
			for {
				select {
				case c := <-a.queue:
					c.done <- roomAnswer{err: ErrBusy}
				default:
					return
				}
			}
		case c := <-a.queue:
			if !a.accepting.Load() {
				c.done <- roomAnswer{err: ErrBusy}
				continue
			}
			if err := c.ctx.Err(); err != nil {
				c.done <- roomAnswer{err: err}
				continue
			}
			out, err := a.execute(c.ctx, c.request)
			c.done <- roomAnswer{out, err}
		}
	}
}
func (a *Actor) execute(ctx context.Context, c RoomRequest) (RoomReply, error) {
	r := a.room
	out := RoomReply{}
	if r.stopped || c.Epoch != r.record.Epoch {
		return out, ErrRule
	}
	var err error
	switch c.Op {
	case "bind":
		err = r.bind(c.PlayerID, c.PlayerSID, c.Epoch, c.Session)
	case "disconnect":
		found := false
		for i, m := range r.record.Members {
			if m.PlayerID == c.PlayerID && m.SID == c.PlayerSID {
				found = true
				r.match.DetachSession(lockstep.PlayerID(i+1), c.Session)
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			err = ErrRule
		}
	case "input":
		err = r.input(c.Epoch, c.Session, c.Frame, c.Payload)
	case "catchup":
		err = r.catchup(c.Epoch, c.Session, c.Frame)
	case "tick":
		out.Frame, err = r.tick(ctx)
	case "state":
	case "replay":
		if c.Frame == 0 || int(c.Frame) > len(r.record.Frames)+1 {
			return out, ErrRule
		}
		end := min(len(r.record.Frames), int(c.Frame)-1+lockstep.MaxBroadcastFrames)
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(r.record.Frames[int(c.Frame)-1 : end])
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &out.Frames); err != nil {
			return out, err
		}
	default:
		return out, ErrRule
	}
	if r.record.Reference != nil {
		out.Digest = r.record.Reference.Digest()
	}
	out.Next = r.match.NextFrame()
	return out, err
}
func (a *Actor) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
	a.once.Do(func() { a.accepting.Store(false); close(a.stop) })
	select {
	case <-a.done:
		return nil
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return ctx.Err()
	}
}

// HostEndpoint 是原服到 battle host 的私有 RPC 边界：FromSID 来自受信任服务总线，
// PlayerID / Session 必须来自原服已鉴权的连接上下文，不能把公网请求原样转发到这里。
// 固定十个绑定槽避免重连使身份表无限增长；客户端和观战者没有 tick / 管理权限。
type HostEndpoint struct {
	actor    *Actor
	record   Round
	adminSID int32
	mu       sync.Mutex
	bindings [ArenaSeats]nettransport.SessionID
}

func NewHostEndpoint(actor *Actor, r Round, adminSID int32) *HostEndpoint {
	return &HostEndpoint{actor: actor, record: r, adminSID: adminSID}
}
func (e *HostEndpoint) Call(ctx context.Context, fromSID int32, c RoomRequest) (RoomReply, error) {
	e.mu.Lock()
	defer e.mu.Unlock()
	if c.Op == "tick" || c.Op == "state" {
		if fromSID != e.adminSID {
			return RoomReply{}, ErrRule
		}
		return e.actor.Call(ctx, c)
	}
	index := -1
	for i, m := range e.record.Members {
		if m.PlayerID == c.PlayerID && m.SID == fromSID && m.SID == c.PlayerSID {
			index = i
			break
		}
	}
	if index < 0 || c.Session == 0 {
		return RoomReply{}, ErrRule
	}
	switch c.Op {
	case "bind":
		out, err := e.actor.Call(ctx, c)
		if err == nil {
			e.bindings[index] = c.Session
		}
		return out, err
	case "disconnect":
		if e.bindings[index] != c.Session {
			return RoomReply{}, nil
		}
		out, err := e.actor.Call(ctx, c)
		if err == nil {
			e.bindings[index] = 0
		}
		return out, err
	case "input", "replay", "catchup":
		if e.bindings[index] != c.Session {
			return RoomReply{}, ErrRule
		}
		return e.actor.Call(ctx, c)
	default:
		return RoomReply{}, ErrRule
	}
}

// ObserverFrames 由业务观战 API 在完成 ACL 后调用；直播延迟至少一帧，每页至多框架协议上限。
// 不绑定英雄控制权，不把全输入帧同步伪装成对恶意客户端的战争迷雾保密。
func (r Round) ObserverFrames(approved bool, from lockstep.FrameID, delay int) ([]lockstep.Frame, error) {
	if !approved || delay < 1 || delay > int(MaxFrames) || from == 0 || int(from) > len(r.Frames)+1 {
		return nil, ErrRule
	}
	head := max(0, len(r.Frames)-delay)
	if int(from) > head {
		return nil, nil
	}
	end := min(head, int(from)-1+lockstep.MaxBroadcastFrames)
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(r.Frames[int(from)-1 : end])
	var frames []lockstep.Frame
	err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &frames)
	return frames, err
}
